parked.spanish: Y tomó Moisés las carretas y el ganado, y dio a ellos a los levitas.

findings.issue: אוֹתָם is the direct object (them: the carts and the herd). אֶל הַלְוִיִּם is the only recipient. “a ellos a los levitas” marks both the pronoun and the Levites as recipients and does not give the carts and herd as the thing given.

parked.spanish: Macho cabrío de cabras uno a pecado.

findings.issue: Lemma l/2403 b is the sin-offering noun with לְ; «a pecado» states generic sin and omits the offering.

parked.spanish: Y todo ganado de sacrificio de los pazes: veinte y cuatro toros, carneros sesenta, chivos sesenta, corderos hijos de año sesenta; esta dedicación del altar después de ser ungido a él.

findings.issue: השלמים is the definite plural peace-offering noun; «pazes» is a malformed plural of abstract paz and does not name that offering class.

Niphal infinitive המשׁח is passive «be anointed», and אתו is its 3ms direct object (the patient). «ser ungido a él» turns the suffix into a recipient («anointed to him») and leaves the patient unnamed.
